thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: SEV-2 - elevated error rates and 5xxs on /v1/generate in canary — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-failures 

olivia: I'm on it. seeing a spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate around 23:10 UTC. Can see canary traffic trending up.

devon: I see a cluster of 403/KMS Decrypt errors in the affected pods' logs that started at the same time as the canary rollout.

sanjay: Did we rotate any keys or update IAM around that deploy? I have a note about a KMS rotation yesterday for the dedicated clusters.

olivia: Copy. Pulling pod logs now. sample: ```2026-03-15T23:12:03Z ERROR inference-runtime: Failed to load model keys: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/redwood-task-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/abcd-ef01-2345```

talia: We did rotate the KMS key alias in us-west-2 yesterday after the key-rekey job. The new alias was supposed to be reattached to the task role via infra-iam change. Did that land?

devon: Checking git history — infra-iam PR merged but the CloudFormation change didn't apply to the dedicated deployment stack because of a drift in the stack parameters. So new task role lacks kms:Decrypt on the new key ARN.

olivia: Impact summary: canary traffic (5% of prod) saw ~20% failures per request for about 7 minutes. Hosted clusters not affected; Dedicated clusters with new key alias were. Support already got two escalations.

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-1923501123. Start timeline entry: "KMS permission errors after canary rollout".

sanjay: Mitigation plan: 1) disable canary feature flag to stop routing new traffic to canary 2) rollback canary image to previous stable tag 3) if rollback fails, fallback to old KMS alias via alias swap 4) patch IAM/CloudFormation and re-deploy controlled change.

talia: I can flip the LaunchDarkly flag now (canary-serving). Doing it via UI/API.

talia: ```bash
# example, not real token
curl -X PATCH "https://app.launchdarkly.com/api/v2/flags/redwood/canary-serving" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"environments": {"production": {"on": false}}}'
```

olivia: Flag flipped. Metrics: error rate on /v1/generate dropping in the next minute. :white_check_mark:

devon: Rolling back canary image to tag v1.12.3 in us-west-2: ```kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-canary inference=redwood/inference:v1.12.3 && kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-canary -n inference```

olivia: Rollback complete for canary. Error rate back to baseline. Some pods still show transient 5xx on restart but stabilizing.

sanjay: I'll submit a hotfix to infra-iam to add kms:Decrypt for the task role on the key ARN and run a controlled CFN update against the dedicated stacks. I'll also open a runbook item to prevent alias-only rotations without role update.

mike: Customer impact note: two mid-market customers reported ~10-15% failed requests between 23:12 and 23:19 UTC. Support already sent initial notice; we'll need a short follow-up with timeline and root cause.

support-bot: Ticket #SUP-4592 created and linked to this incident.

olivia: On-call handoff: I'll stay on until 02:00 UTC to make sure no regression. devon, can you take the 02:00->08:00 UTC handoff and follow the IAM PR?

devon: I'll take handoff and monitor. I'll also verify the infra-iam patch deploy and re-run canary rollout in a gated manner once IAM changes are confirmed.

incident-bot: SEV-2 -> mitigated at 23:21 UTC. Add follow-up tasks: postmortem, customer comms, infra-iam hotfix review.

olivia: Postmortem owners: devon (root cause and infra fix), talia (rollback & flag playbook), sanjay (IAM/CFN).

mike: I'll draft a short customer update and a cross-team blameless postmortem template.

olivia: Quick notes for postmortem: root cause = KMS alias rotation + drifted CFN parameter so role missing kms:Decrypt; contributing = canary rollouts with new key before IAM patch applied, no gating on KMS permission checks.

talia: Action: add a pre-rollout check to the deployment pipeline to verify kms:Decrypt for task role against any referenced key aliases.

olivia: Thanks team. Keeping thread open until IAM PR deployed and we confirm no regressions. :coffee:

support-bot: Notification: customers updated with initial incident summary.

incident-bot: Thread closed for paging; monitoring continues.

olivia: closing here, will update the postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
